label: vlog
summary: Personal vlog: handheld, direct address to camera, jump cuts, POV inserts, natural light.
source: Maestro guideline from vlog conventions; not measured on a corpus.

rhythm.note: trim the pauses out of a talk with jump cuts; B-roll and POV inserts stay short

camera: handheld at arm's length for direct address (selfie framing, slight sway); walk-and-talk tracking; POV inserts; no shot/reverse
look: natural available light: daylight from a window, golden hour outside, practical lamps at night; no stylised grade
acting: natural and casual; looks into the lens when speaking, away when thinking; small genuine reactions
motifs: jump cuts inside one talk (same framing, small change of pose)
POV inserts of hands doing the thing (coffee, keys, a map)
short B-roll of the place to open a segment
do: the speaker addresses the lens; the audience is the other character
dont: no studio lighting, crane moves or cinematic shot/reverse
no readable signs or screens (text renders badly)
